roles.functionStatement: Give fire managers timely, validated intelligence on fire activity and expected behaviour, with its confidence stated, so that resources are ordered on evidence.

credentialGates.label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)

instruments.label: Secretarial Order 3448 establishing the U.S. Wildland Fire Service

majorDuties.duty: Fuse multi-source fire intelligence into operational decision support

tasks.statement: Integrate satellite detections, camera feeds, weather and resource status into a continuously updated situation summary for dispatch
Adjudicate an automated fire detection against cameras, public reports and other sensors before resources are ordered
Brief duty officers and incident commanders on fire activity, predicted growth and resource needs at each operational period
Track the accuracy of detections and spread predictions against observed outcomes, reporting systematic errors to programme managers

majorDuties.duty: Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning

tasks.statement: Predict fire spread, intensity and spotting for an operational period from fuels, weather and topography, stating assumptions
Compare modelled fire behaviour with observed behaviour during an incident, adjusting predictions and recording each discrepancy

majorDuties.duty: Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Brief incident or programme leaders on the confidence of fire behaviour and weather projections, updating the briefing when observations diverge.
Quantify the dominant sources of uncertainty in an analysis, such as measurement, sampling, model and scenario, stating which result would change the recommendation.

majorDuties.duty: Build, run and validate environmental forecast and scenario systems

tasks.statement: Maintain an operational forecast system's data feeds and model versions, re-validating after each change before results are released.

majorDuties.duty: Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions

tasks.statement: Interpret satellite and aerial imagery to detect changes in vegetation, soil or water condition across a management area between two dates.

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Verify an AI-generated field product, such as a condition map or drafted inspection note, against observations made at the site before it is relied on
Escalate an AI-generated output that conflicts with field evidence, recording the conflicting observation for the analyst and the decision-maker

majorDuties.duty: Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data

tasks.statement: Analyze terrain, habitat connectivity or resource distribution for a planning question, stating the data, projection and accuracy limits that bound the answer.

majorDuties.duty: Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence

tasks.statement: Check whether a planned use of a model output falls inside the model's intended purpose, data period and area before relying on it.
